userRegistry.note: deterministic VerifiableFactory address for (ops key, salt); same before and after deployment

order: Ops key deploys the registry + artists first (agent-sent, needs funding), then Shaka signs set-subregistry. Order is safe either way: before activation the names simply do not resolve.

txs.title: Send 0.00035 ETH to the OSO ops key (gas for 5 artists)
txs.plain: A normal ETH transfer from your wallet to the OSO registrar/ops key 0xe70050DF1587aA0E5CBD5735D448E5A9C9392293. It pays the gas to create the OSO artist registry and 5 artist names + their own resolvers. Skip this if a teammate funds the ops key instead.

txs.title: Activate osoartist.eth: point its subnames at the OSO artist registry
txs.plain: Calls ETHRegistry.setSubregistry on YOUR name osoartist.eth so that <artist>.osoartist.eth is looked up in the OSO UserRegistry 0xE9d4002cb12a53b50FAA244Cf801Ced40D7c3b48. Each artist's name in that registry is owned by the artist's own wallet; neither OSO nor you can take it back, change its resolver or its payout (fork-tested). You can later re-point osoartist.eth (that is the one power you keep) unless you also sign the optional lock.

txs.title: OPTIONAL · IRREVERSIBLE: give up re-pointing osoartist.eth forever
txs.plain: Revokes your own SET_SUBREGISTRY role (and its admin) on osoartist.eth. After this nobody — not you, not OSO — can swap the artist registry out from under the artists. You keep ownership, renewal and resolver of osoartist.eth. Do NOT sign tonight unless you are sure; it cannot be undone.
